title: Etaleness is local on source and target
statement: For a morphism of schemes, being etale at a point is unchanged after restricting to open neighbourhoods of the source point and its image; equivalently, etaleness may be checked on affine neighbourhoods of source and target.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 29.37.3, Tag 02GN (etale is a local property of ring maps; the lemma also records stability under composition)
